brief:
Israeli military checkpoints have sealed off several villages in the northwestern area of Jerusalem, according to the Ma'an news agency. The blockade restricts movement between the affected communities and surrounding areas, limiting residents' ability to travel freely throughout the region.

The isolation measure has disrupted daily life for villagers who depend on access to services, employment opportunities, and trade routes extending beyond their immediate localities. Schools, hospitals, and markets in neighboring areas have become difficult or impossible for residents to reach. Checkpoint operations have created significant barriers to commerce and commerce-dependent livelihoods.

No official statement regarding the duration or justification for the checkpoint deployment has been released. Residents face continued restrictions on their movement as the blockade remains in place.
title: Israeli checkpoints isolate villages northwest of Jerusalem.
